title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 110
paragraphs: The Ionians made answer in these words. Afterwards, when the Persians had come to the plain of Salamis, the kings of the Cyprians drew up their battle order, choosing the best of the troops of Salamis and Soli to face the Persians, and setting the other Cyprians against the rest of the enemy's forces; and against Artybius, the commander of the Persians, Onesilus took up his place in the line by his own free choice.
